name: Le Reve Dore Inspired by La Vie Est Belle | Premium Women’s Sweet Perfume
description: Le Reve Dore, inspired by the beloved Lancôme La Vie Est Belle, is a warm, sweet, and radiant women’s perfume crafted for those who love luxurious gourmand-floral fragrances. It opens with a juicy blend of pear and blackcurrant, offering a fresh and feminine introduction. As the scent blooms, a graceful floral heart of iris, jasmine, and orange blossom takes over—creating a soft, elegant aura. The base features creamy praline, vanilla, tonka bean, and patchouli, giving the fragrance its signature sweet, cozy, and long-lasting finish. Made with a high perfume-oil concentration, Le Reve Dore provides exceptional longevity and projection, making it perfect for daily wear, evening outings, weddings, and special events. Warm, feminine, and irresistibly sweet, this fragrance embodies happiness, elegance, and modern femininity—exclusively brought to you by Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Pear, Blackcurrant Heart Notes: Iris, Jasmine, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Praline, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Patchouli Longevity: 8–10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for daily wear, evenings, and special events Why Choose Le Rêve Doré? Inspired by the bestselling La Vie Est Belle Rich gourmand-floral notes with premium sweetness High perfume-oil concentration for a lasting impression Exclusive luxury women’s perfume by Scents by Aamir
story: Le Reve Dore, inspired by La Vie Est Belle, blends pear, blackcurrant, floral notes, and creamy praline to create a warm, sweet, and elegant long-lasting women’s fragrance.
